insights: Home advantage strongly anchors baseline expectations, as reflected in the historical dataset distribution where home wins account for 44.8% of outcomes.

Corner kick differential (HC vs AC) exhibits minimal predictive weight (<4%) compared to shot efficiency and direct goal metrics.
match_outcome.summary: Multi-layer Perceptron (MLP) trained on 217,071 historical match records using learning rate 0.05 across 50 epochs. Optimized for predicting match outcome based on offensive performance indices and home advantage indicators.

insights: Shots on target metrics (HST and AST) account for nearly 38% of total predictive weight, serving as the strongest indicator for both teams scoring.
The dataset baseline exhibits a slight positive bias with 51.7% BTTS Yes occurrences across 217,071 records, aligning with average home/away goals of 1.50 and 1.14.
Corners (HC, AC) show a moderate secondary contribution (10.0% combined) towards maintaining offensive pressure sufficient for mutual goal outcomes.
both_teams_to_score.summary: Fully Connected MLP model trained for 50 epochs on 217,071 fixtures to predict Both Teams To Score (BTTS). Achieved 74.83% accuracy and 0.7594 F1-score utilizing shot and goal metric dynamics.

insights: Shots on target ratio (HST vs AST) serves as a heavy non-linear driver for the MLP model, complementing actual goal variables.
The inherent home bias (1.50 mean home goals vs 1.14 away goals) is reflected in higher weight allocations for home match telemetry.
